description: Flutter Package for Easier Creation of Home Screen Widgets

latest_release.name: home_widget-v0.9.2
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat: Support passing appGroupId directly with functions by @ABausG in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/416
* fix: Pin android dependency versions to prevent pre-release pickup by @shenlong-tanwen in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/418
* fix: Support Android Gradle Plugin 9.x by @giaquo in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/420
* fix: Add FlutterFramework to iOS SPM package by @merlinnot in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/419
* chore(release): Publish packages by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/422

## New Contributors
* @shenlong-tanwen made their first contribution in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/418
* @giaquo made their first contribution in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/420
* @merlinnot made their first contribution in https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/pull/419

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ABausG/home_widget/compare/home_widget-v0.9.1...home_widget-v0.9.2
